chapter: Early bands, Calloway to Basie and Kansas City (third typescript)
title: Few rehearsals in Basie's band, drinking and being fired
summary: In his time the Basie band rehearsed once or twice a week; he drank, dozed under the stage lights, got few solos in the crowded stage shows and was fired.

story.theme_name: Playing with Count Basie: joining, leading, leaving
story.community_name: Playing with Count Basie: the band, its feel and its people

blocks.x: Just before we get away from rehearsals things. You know it surprised me a little when Lester said that about Basie's band because it seems to sound like such a loose band. And you'd figure they'd spend a lot of time rehearsing -- I mean running through things. But maybe there was a change around this space of time.

Well there was, because when I was in the band we didn't do all that much rehearsing you know. We didn't do all that much rehearsing. We rehearsed maybe once or twice a week. You understand? And it was the guy in the music and then later got. And probably that's when left the band you know. I got the plans for Thursday. I mean I was fired that day.
Cause I just -- I'd be talking about -- I'd just say -- I used to get high with juice you know.
Too much juice I guess and I'd go to sleep. Cause the light would be shining right in my eyes. And they's shine the (unintelligible) on the stage.
Were you doing a lot of stage shows then?
Yeah. And that beam would get right into my eyes. And I'd have to close them because I couldn't hardly see the music on account of this bright light in my eyes.

And -- and so I didn't have no solo to play so -- you know -- there I was -- you know. They usually didn't stage shows that we had to play (unintelligible) (Inaudible). And they had so many soloists in the band you know. Earl and --
Jack Washington never got much to play in either --
No. and there was -- oh, what's his name -- played the other trombones.
Dan Minor. He never got a chance to (unintelligible) in it either.
I think he recorded one solo as a (inaudible).

Yeah. Well, you know -- we didn't have too much to do, so he didn't get like what I did cause I guess he had his wife looking after him to keep him from -- to keep him from -- you know -- keep him from drinking so much. Ah -- that's the way I was.
